bug_locations: paginate: size guard changed from 'size < 0' to 'size <= 0'
paginate: initial start for cursor=None changed from 1 to 0
paginate: cursor parsing changed from 'int(cursor)+1' to 'int(cursor)' with added range validation (negative or beyond-end cursors raise ValueError)
explanation: The implementation treated cursors as one-based: it started at index 1 when no cursor was given and added 1 to every supplied cursor, so pages were shifted and the visible check failed. The specification says cursors are zero-based start indices, so the default start is 0 and a supplied cursor is used directly via int(cursor). The size guard only rejected negative sizes, but the spec requires nonpositive sizes to raise ValueError, so it now uses size <= 0. Finally, int() alone only rejects non-numeric cursor strings; explicit bounds checking was added so negative or out-of-range cursors (invalid per the spec) also raise ValueError instead of silently producing wrong slices.
